root.label: EU home affairs ministers meet on border controls and Frontex

events.label: EU plans to strengthen Frontex rapid intervention force October 2026
EU home affairs ministers meet on border controls and Frontex

slots.name: participating countries
slots.sentence: Home affairs ministers from the EU’s 27 countries gathered in Luxembourg to discuss border surveillance and other policies, including setting up “ return hubs ” in third countries and efforts to increase deportations across the bloc.

slots.name: Frontex budget
slots.sentence: The agency is already one of the most well funded EU organizations with a budget of 1.2 billion euros ($1.3 billion) in 2026.

slots.name: return regulation status
slots.sentence: Following the talks, they approved a new regulation to boost deportations of irregular migrants.

slots.name: 2015 arrivals
slots.sentence: Anti-immigration sentiment has remained a potent political force across Europe since more than a million people, many of them Syrians fleeing war, arrived in the bloc in 2015.

slots.name: date
slots.sentence: European Union officials met Thursday to strengthen border controls and curb migration as activists presented new evidence they say shows the bloc’s border agency provides surveillance data to Libya’s coast guard to intercept migrants at sea.

slots.name: migration pact effect date
slots.sentence: Greek Migration Minister Thanos Plevris said the EU’s migration pact, which took effect in June, had improved the bloc’s ability to manage migration flows but had not gone far enough.

slots.name: emergency framework announcement date
slots.sentence: Plevris’s proposal comes two weeks after European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said the commission would present an emergency framework allowing member states to respond to sudden, large-scale arrivals.

events.label: Greece proposes emergency asylum suspension October 1 2026

slots.name: proposal status
slots.sentence: On Thursday, Greece even proposed temporarily suspending asylum applications in emergency situations.
